questions.stem: Carbon-14 has a half-life of 5,730 years. It is useful for dating objects up to approximately how old?
questions.explanation: Carbon-14 dating is useful for dating organic remains up to about 50,000 years old. Beyond this, the amount of carbon-14 remaining is too small to measure accurately. For older rocks, uranium dating (half-life ~4.5 billion years) is used instead.
